tests.execution_scope: Actual staged durable transport and fetchIALD slices executed in VM with real pinned ESM codec/browser API implementations in Node; fetch stub. Not full DOM startup or mobile WebView.

assets.required_mime: text/javascript or application/javascript for both ESM resources
assets.backend_contract: Authenticated existing session.transport with protocol/codec/bases/query; GET page query transport=iald-byte-envelope-v1. No extra headers/CORS change. POST response remains ordinary job JSON. Unknown uncertain request recovered by GET identity, never resubmitted.
assets.service_worker: Existing /api exclusion retained byte-identically; modules not precached. Failed lazy import is memoized unavailable; no reload.
assets.not_authorized: No installation, server edit, publication or store build in this client subtask.

behavior: Authenticated existing session call negotiates; memoized lazy local ESM import; unsupported before-send retains identity.
prepareRequest receives complete original JSON UTF8; no truncation or payload mutation.
Existing fetchIALD auth/credentials code preserved byte-for-text; one POST; persisted attempted flag blocks uncertain and concurrent resubmission.
Uncertain POST recovers by GET request ID, never by re-POST; explicit no-dispatch HTTP error also does not automatically retry.
Negotiated pages read with bound and verified for scope/job/cursor/hash before durable loop sees events or advances cursor.
No visual/CSS/science/memory edits; index and service worker copied byte-identically; failed import never reloads page.
integration_dependencies: Backend must add exactly the two .mjs allowlist entries with JavaScript MIME and implement frozen session/POST/page contract.
Parent/reviewer must validate deployed WebView/Safari feature probe and backend before installation.
No codec cache/bases/delta enabled; frozen stateless envelope contract retained.
limitations: Existing browser persisted store is not a multi-tab atomic lock; single-instance concurrent submissions tested, server idempotency remains mandatory.
Response bounded reader limits accumulated payload, not browser internal allocation.
Module unavailable or cached prior feature failure stays identity for page lifetime.
Local pending request whose uncertain POST cannot be found remains pending; no automatic full replay.
